text:
Maya: Quick ask 1 11 Launch next Tue. Do we pause the usual weekly newsletter that week and run a tight launch-focused drip + a short re-engage for quiet subs? Need a decision by EOD so ops can lock calendar.
Sam: i'm for pausing the wide weekly. keeps inbox real estate clean. propose: 1) launch announcement, 2) how-to/quickstart, 3) case study deep dive. only send the second two to engaged cohort.
Priya: agree on pause. also want to clean list first to improve deliverability and engagement metrics. suggest snooze criteria: opens <2 in 90d -> move to "re-engage" bucket. Run 2 re-engage sends; if still inactive after another 90d, add to prune/suppression.
Evan: can you show expected list sizes? need to know how many will be snoozed vs kept. ops will need to budget sends for re-engage.
Maya: current subscribed audience ~ 318,742. Active (open in 90d) = 97,410. So snooze candidate pool ≈ 221,332. If reactivation at 6% -> ~13k come back. net active after sweep ~110k.
Priya: re-engage copy sketch:
- Email A (day0): "Weve updated Redwood  Quick highlights inside"
- Email B (day4): "Low-latency benchmarks + 3 tips for production"
Subject A/B for first re-engage: A = "Weve missed you Check out whats new" vs B = "Quick benchmark highlights inside"
Sam: also test send windows: 10am local vs 3pm local. split by timezone region. track opens & click lift.
Evan: ops notes: we can run an export with tag logic. Need final SQL and exclusions. we'll exclude paying customers, trials <365d, and the webinar invite list. Also honor snooze_opt_out flag.
Priya: SQL snippet for Snooze cohort:
```sql
SELECT id, email
FROM newsletter_subscribers
WHERE status = 'subscribed'
  AND last_open_at < now() - interval '90 days'
  AND (last_click_at IS NULL OR last_click_at < now() - interval '90 days')
  AND snooze_opt_out = false
  AND NOT exists (select 1 from webinar_invites where webinar_id = 'launch_2026' and webinar_invites.email = newsletter_subscribers.email);
```
Maya: timeline:
- Today EOD: decide pause vs send weekly (EOD = now).
- Tomorrow noon: creative locked.
- Tomorrow EOD: ops supply suppression CSV.
- Launch week: run re-engage day0 & day4; prune list 90d after re-engage fail.
Ops: will add tag `pruned_launch2026_v1` for pruned addresses and upload to MailProvider suppression.
Sam: KPI expectations: by removing ~220k inert subs we expect open rate to move from ~12% -> ~14-15% (2-3pp uplift), CTR slightly higher. Worth including in exec comms.
Evan: scheduling check: is it ok to send the launch announcement to the snooze group if they re-engage on day0? ops: yes, we can add them back into campaign flows if they open/click within X hours. define X?
Priya: define X = 24 hours. if they open within 24h of re-engage send, include them in launch cohort.
Maya: action items summarized:
- Priya: finalize subject lines + brief creative for re-engage and launch assets by tomorrow 12:00.
- Sam: prepare the A/B plan & timezone split logic.
- Evan: run export + generate suppression CSV, deliver by EOD tomorrow.
- Ops: schedule sends + wire A/B tests in ESP; implement restore-if-opened logic (24h).
marketing-bot: Campaign created: "launch_march_2026" (id cm_2026_03_launch_m)  assets pending.
Maya: i'll draft a single-slide comm for execs showing expected metric impact and the rationale. will share before EOD.
Sam: no objections here. go ahead.
Priya: dropping subject lines in the doc now. will ping when done.
Evan: starting export job now. will post CSV link when ready.
